name: Knol & Kool Bistro & Superet
info: Organic vegan cafe, restaurant, juice bar, and shop. On the brunch & lunch menu offers dishes like a full English breakfast, banana bread, and pancakes. The dinner menu features dishes like salads, burgers, lasagna, and spaghetti bolognese. Vegan cakes, baked treats, acai, fresh juices, coffee, and tea available. Also has a vegan supermarket attached, which stocks food and other items. Outdoor seating. Wheelchair accessible. Accepts credit cards. Free Wi-Fi. Wed-Fri 11:00-21:00, Sat 10:00-21:00, Sun 09:00-16:00

name: Lekker GEC
info: Buffet restaurant with small à la carte. Self-service by weight - your plate goes on the scale; you take what you like as much as you like and pay for just that. Has shakes and ice cream. Also information centre for ecology. Day meals served 12:00pm-2:30pm and 6:00pm-8:30pm. Reported fully vegan August 2021.  Tue-Sat 12:00-21:00, Sun 11:00-15:00

name: Lokaal
info: Little tea house and restaurant, established in late-2014 and turned vegan in 2018. Makes salads, soups, sandwiches. Large front windows let in natural sunlight and create a pleasant atmosphere.

name: Nonna Gent
info: Pasta restaurant offering veganizable Italian-inspired dishes like "Vegan Bolo" (a plant-based version of bolognese). Also features a variety of vegetable toppings to customize meals, including sun-dried tomatoes, pine nuts, and crispy onions. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Sun 11:30-21:30

name: O'YO - Brabantdam
info: A breakfast, lunch and coffee bar with meals that are yogurt based. Vegan except for dairy milk products and honey. The sweet meals have choices like coconut yogurt with house-made chocolate buckwheat granola and fresh seasonal fruits. Oatmeal, made from oats and vegan milk, with or without yogurt. All the cakes and pies are vegan. The savory meals are plant-based salads with a savory yogurt dip and a protein topping of your choice. Choose the balance bowl if you prefer a salad with lots of veggies, hummus and chickpeas. Takes reservations for groups of 8 people or more. Card payment only. Accepts credit cards. Free Wi-Fi. Mon-Sun 09:00-17:00

name: O'YO - Sint Baafs
info: Second location of this vegetarian breakfast, brunch and lunch bar. Has a focus on healthy bowls, toasts and pancakes.  Mon-Sun 09:00-17:00

name: Amour
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Buffet style lunch, brunch, apero & dinner with seasonal and local products. The majority of the dishes are vegetarian and vegan and can include noodle salad with crispy chili, cauliflower & carrot, cucumber salad with dill & citrus, artichoke & mushroom salad with arugula & mustard dressing, marinated mushrooms, pickled radishes, house-made spreads, and more.  Mon-Fri 12:00-14:00, Fri 18:00-21:00

name: Aywa
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Lebanese restaurant with various typical Lebanese dishes. Includes hummus, fattoush, falafel, grilled eggplant, batata hara and stuffed vine leaves. Check these are vegan. Cash only. Tue-Sat 12:00-14:30, 17:00-22:00

name: Basta Resto
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Restaurant offering clearly marked vegan dishes such as Buddha bowl, penne, vegetable stew and a cake. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Fri 12:00-14:30, 17:00-22:00, Sat-Sun 12:00-22:00

name: Beiruti
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Lebanese restaurant offering a selection of tradition vegan dishes including hummus, falafel, baba ganoush, spinach fatayer, stuffed vine leaves, pastries, tasting dishes and more. Low waste and plastic free. Outdoor seating. Accepts credit cards. Free Wi-Fi. Mon-Wed 10:00-21:00, Thu-Sat 10:00-22:00

name: Boker Tov
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Israeli restaurant offering vegan dishes such as hummus, falafel, baba ghanoush, tabbouleh, roasted cauliflower, sweet and sour carrots, challah bread, pecan cheesecake, and rosewater pudding. Please note that the labneh is not vegan and may be mislabeled. Outdoor seating. Reservations required. Wheelchair accessible. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Sat 09:00-21:00, Sun 09:00-16:00

name: Carlton Hotel Restaurant
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. A small hotel offers a buffet breakfast with plenty of freshly cut fruit and dried fruit, in addition to freshly squeezed orange and apple juices. Also has a la carte items in addition to a vegan menu which includes fried cherry tomatoes, small vegan weenies, white beans in tomato sauce, rosti potatoes, oatmeal porridge & french toast. Uses only local products.

name: Eat This
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Experimental food bar with a changing menu. Offers a clearly labeled vegan pizza. Some of the starters may also be vegan, such as the soy shiitake sourdough dumplings - ask staff.  Thu-Sat 18:00-21:30

name: Fitchen - Korenmarkt
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Fresh wraps and plates, made every day in our own kitchen. Every dish comes as a wrap or a plate, with vegan options such as grilled vegan meat. Two shops in Ghent: Korenmarkt and Vlaanderenstraat.  Mon-Sun 11:00-20:00

name: Frituur De Papegaai
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Fast food snack bar. Has labeled vegan choices and sauces. Wheelchair accessible. Mon-Fri 11:30-14:30, 17:00-22:00, Sun 17:00-22:00

name: Gado-Gado

name: Holy Guacamoly
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Mexican burrito shop serving burritos, nachos, and bowls. Burritos are customizable and vegan fillings are available. Other vegan choices include salads and super nacho bowl. Outdoor seating. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Thu 11:30-14:00, 17:00-21:30, Fri 11:30-21:30, Sat 12:00-15:00, Sat-Sun 17:00-21:30

name: Lebanese Restaurant

name: Neo Pizza
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Pizzeria offering a clearly marked vegan pizza with grilled eggplant, garlic, onion, nuts, and pistachio crema. Outdoor seating. Reservations required. Tue-Sun 18:00-22:00

name: Panos
info: Accepts credit cards. Mon-Sat 05:30-20:00, Sun 06:30-20:00

name: Paul's Boutique
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Burger restaurants offering multiple vegetarian burgers and a few vegan ones. The vegan ones are: risotto burger, green patty, hazelnut burger, quinoa burger. Order is served standard with a crispy bun, lettuce, tomato & onion. Be sure to ask for vegan sauce. A 10-minute walk historical center. NOTE: Regular burger buns are not vegan - gluten free buns are vegan but cost extra. Relocated from Sint-Amandsstraat 48. Cash only. Mon-Thu 11:00-15:00, 17:00-21:00, Fri 11:00-14:30

name: Poke n Pasta
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Poke bowl and pasta restaurant offering vegan choices such as poke bowls with tofu and sweet potato, kimchi ramen, edamame, vegetable gyoza, vegetable spring rolls, pasta salad, vegetable sushi, tofu burrito and vegetable curry. Accepts credit cards. Tue-Sat 11:30-14:00, Tue-Sun 17:00-22:00

name: Pureto
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Flemish mashed potato restaurant with vegan "boudin" sausages. Other vegan items include mashed broccoli potatoes and a seasonal dish.  Mon-Sun 11:30-21:30

name: Ruby's Lunchbar
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Restaurant serving a variety of dishes from different cuisines for breakfast and lunch. Offers vegan choices such as plant-based milk alternatives for coffee & tea, Punjabi kaju masala, roasted miso portobello mushrooms with garlic pea puree & chimichurri, tofu tikka masala and more. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Fri 09:30-15:00

name: Umamido - Vooruit
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Japanese ramen noodle bar offering vegetarian ramen that can be made vegan by ordering without egg. Choose from veggie tantan noodles, shoyu ramen, miso ramen and silken tofu mazemen. Outdoor seating. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Thu 12:00-21:30, Fri-Sat 12:00-22:00, Sun 12:00-21:30

name: Woest
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Lunch, brunch & grill place offering vegan choices upon request such as toast, grilled pineapple, tofu & burgers. Menu states they have non-veggie or veggie options for certain dishes, so vegans please inquire. Reservations accepted. Outdoor seating. Accepts credit cards. Mon-Thu 11:30-14:30, Fri 11:30-00:00, Sat 09:00-00:00, Sun 09:00-15:00

name: Yeti Gent
info: Serves meat, vegan options available. Bar offering options like vegan croissant, granola with fresh fruit (vegan option), and "Samosa Chat" (vegan option). Also features specifically labeled vegan choices including vanilla ice cream and various coffee drinks like cappuccino, latte, and flat white which can be prepared with dairy-free alternatives.  Mon 09:00-18:00, Wed-Thu 09:00-18:00, Fri 09:00-20:00, Sat 10:00-20:00, Sun 10:00-18:00

name: BE Vegan

name: Bubbles at Home

Book the food truck or request for catering by filling out the form on the website. Accepts credit cards. Tue 11:30-14:00, 17:00-20:00, Fri 17:00-20:00

info: Vegan chocolate shop offering pralines, chocolate buttons, bars, and chocolate coated nuts. Available for delivery via the web shop. Can accommodate pick-up orders by preorder only. No storefront. The name, Craac, stands for "Crazy about chocolate."  Mon 09:00-17:00, Wed-Sat 09:00-17:00

name: De Kapperie

name: Dosha Aveda Lifestyle Salon & Spa

name: Rabot op je bord
info: A social project, part of de Sociale Kruideniers Gent vzw. Together with volunteers, they make vegan soups, stews, spreads, hummus, sambal, etc., out of food waste. Everyone is welcome to cook (check Facebook for the dates) and help to reduce food waste and bring people together. You can buy the products in the small bar (where you can have free coffee and tea) or in the social shop. In the house is also a second hand clothes shop and every Friday noon is a free stuff shop.  Mon-Thu 14:00-17:00, Fri 11:00-16:00

name: rokko
info: Est. April 2024. A feminist, queer, radical bookstore + vegan coffee bar co-op. Offers coffee drinks, pastries, lunch and a daily soup - also has a solidarity price option. Wheelchair accessible. Accepts credit cards. Free Wi-Fi. Wed-Sun 10:00-18:00

name: Vegamuze

name: What The Food
info: Caterer offering delivery of frozen vegan meals across Ghent by bike. Menu is inspired by the owner's travels and includes varied dishes such as peanut stew, butter 'chicken', chili sin carne, and red curry. Every dish comes with suggestions for side dish and garniture. Frozen meals are delivered by bike on Tuesdays and Thursday evenings. Available or pick-up at Lange Violettestraat 42, Ghent, as well. Also for sale in Delhaize Proxy Kouter and Viggo's coffee in Antwerp. For private catering inquiries get in touch through the website.  Mon-Sat 09:00-21:00
